name: unpoller-638da756-blind15-ots
instr:
# unpoller: fifteen quiet regressions in gathering and publishing, without a test suite

This deployment watches my network gear, gathers readings and records off it, and ships them to a couple of monitoring destinations while also answering scrapes of its own. Since the last sync of this tree it has gone strange in a lot of small ways at once, and I cannot find a single explanation for it. Nothing about my hardware, my credentials or my configuration changed. The repository has received 15 separate undocumented edits.

The first thing anyone notices is that neither of my long-running publishing paths puts anything anywhere. A scheduled pass aimed at the line-protocol time-series store finishes almost instantly, reports success, and writes nothing whatsoever — not one measurement, and no database is ever touched. The pass that feeds the agent-based sink, the one that speaks in gauges, counts and timings, ends the same way: it returns happily and the agent receives nothing at all. What feeds those paths is broken as well. Combining a freshly gathered bundle of readings with a bundle of alarm and anomaly records now yields only the readings, exactly as if the second bundle had been empty, so nothing derived from alarms reaches either destination. And simply asking the configured upstream sources for those alarm and anomaly records always comes back with a failure attached, even when every source answered fine and the records themselves are right there.
